about_the_game:
Break your opponents!

A Beast Collecting - Roguelite Adventure!

We’ve blended monster collecting, strategic deck-building (lite), and the unpredictability of roguelikes into a fast-paced, turn-based beast battler where every choice shapes your journey. Your Beasts determine your deck, your strategy, and your path to victory.

Build your ultimate team, outthink your opponents, and rise to the top of the Turn Break League.

Key Features

  • Tactical Deck-Building with Beasts – Every Beast is accompanied by an element card. Choose wisely to craft a powerful deck, synergize beast abilities, and discover unique Beasts, each with distinct designs, evolutions, elements, and playstyles.

  • A Roguelite World – While this demo only demonstrates 1 set up with changing tiles, the full game broadens the scope! No two journeys are the same. Each attempt to reach the Turn Break League presents new choices, challenges, and rival Breakers with different Beasts and strategies. Take calculated risks, evolve your Beasts, and adapt to a constantly shifting world.

  • Elemental Strategy & Mind Games – Outsmart your opponents in a rock-paper-scissors elemental battle system where knowing when to strike, play, or disrupt with cards is key. Break their turn, seize control, and claim their Beasts as your own.

Do you have what it takes to become an Elite Breaker?

Step into TurnBreak Demo and put your strategy to the test.

short_description: Enter the world of TurnBreak, a roguelite elemental creature-card battler! Collect and evolve powerful teams mid-battle! Form your deck based on your teams elements. Exploit elemental weaknesses to draw cards to become a member of the Turn Breaker League!
